subject: claw-code
title: census 'original' false: self-declared Python-then-Rust rewrite of Claude Code, evidenced by committed surface snapshots of the proprietary tree
evidence: src/__init__.py:1 ('Python porting workspace for the Claude Code rewrite effort'); src/parity_audit.py:7 (archive/claude_code_ts_snapshot/src root), :12-69 (1:1 TS->py module/dir map incl. costHook, replLauncher, upstreamproxy, memdir); src/reference_data/commands_snapshot.json + tools_snapshot.json ('mirrored from archived TypeScript path tools/AgentTool/AgentTool.tsx'); crate name rusty-claude-cli
one_why: The TS snapshot itself is gitignored and absent, and no verbatim proprietary prompt text appears in the Rust tree -- but a per-file surface mirror committed into reference_data is source-level-derivation evidence of the same family as claurst/crab-code, so lineage stats must count four claude-code derivatives, not one leaked port plus originals; concepts-only, clean-room assumption for any effort_for_us.

subject: claw-code
title: Sandbox fail-open to bare sh is announced to the user as 'Filesystem isolation is still active' (it is HOME/TMPDIR env vars)
evidence: rust/crates/runtime/src/bash.rs:314-320,340-347 (no unshare launcher -> Command sh -lc with only HOME/TMPDIR redirected); rust/crates/rusty-claude-cli/src/main.rs:4599 (advisory text claims filesystem isolation remains active on macOS/non-Linux); sandbox.rs:164,210-220 (real jail is Linux unshare --user only)
one_why: Env-var redirection is advisory to nothing -- any command can read/write the real home dir -- yet the product's own diagnostic tells the user a control is bound; below the nanocoder-5 rung precisely because of the misdescription, and the model-settable dangerously_disable_sandbox input channel (bash.rs:28) has no gate at the runtime seam.

subject: claw-code
title: Scripted Anthropic-mock parity harness drives the real CLI end-to-end, and PARITY.md is generated from its output
evidence: rust/crates/rusty-claude-cli/tests/mock_parity_harness.rs:17-171 (12-scenario table incl. write_file_denied, bash_permission_prompt_approved/denied, auto_compact_triggered, token_cost_reporting in a clean env); rust/crates/mock-anthropic-service/src/lib.rs (1,123 LOC deterministic /v1/messages mock); rust/MOCK_PARITY_HARNESS.md + rust/scripts/run_mock_parity_diff.py
one_why: Nuance vs amazon-q/cline entries: the harness's captured-request diff against PARITY.md makes the parity claim itself a CI-consumed artifact instead of prose, and approval-yes/no pairs are scripted as first-class scenarios -- the doc-generating harness is the portable part (subject's own code lineage is license-encumbered, so port the pattern, not the code).

subject: claw-code
title: 19,831-LOC CLI main.rs (plus 10.9k tools/lib.rs, 7.2k commands/lib.rs) holds ~33% of all Rust code above an otherwise-clean loop
evidence: wc -l: rust/crates/rusty-claude-cli/src/main.rs:19,831 (305 top-level fns: run_repl :7048, dispatch :1086-1113, sandbox advisories :4599, ACP status :10632); tools/src/lib.rs:10,892; commands/src/lib.rs:7,183
one_why: Nuance vs crush-5/prime-agent-3: the turn loop itself IS extracted (runtime/conversation.rs:325) and testable, which the rung usually lacks -- but the extraction stops there: REPL, policy messaging, config reports, and error UX fuse into one file 8x crush's docking factor, so every CLI behavior change routes through a file no anchor would open.

subject: claw-code
title: Zero-cost LLM-free compaction fold with tool-pair-safe boundary, flatten-on-merge anti-inflation guard, and a post-compaction session-health probe
evidence: rust/crates/runtime/src/compact.rs:192-287 (mechanical summarizer: role counts, tool dedupe, pending-work inference, 160-char-per-block timeline), :124-163 (walk keep-boundary back so a tool_use/tool_result pair is never split -- prevents OpenAI-compat 400), :290-330 (merge flattens prior highlights: re-nesting compounds ~depth*overhead per cycle); conversation.rs:332-341 (health probe aborts turn with named recovery command after compaction)
one_why: Forge-shaped deterministic fold (zero cost, no summarizer hallucination) but single-tier and lossy on prose; the two details worth porting independently of the lineage question are the pair-safe boundary arithmetic and the recorded anti-nesting merge -- both pinned by tests (compact.rs:574+) and by the auto_compact_triggered e2e scenario.

subject: claw-code
title: Attributed unexpected-cache-break detector monitors a prompt cache the requests never enable (zero cache_control marks)
evidence: grep cache_control over rust/crates: 0 hits; rust/crates/api/src/prompt_cache.rs:314-345 (detect_cache_break: fingerprint-version/model-hash/system-hash attribution, 2,000-token drop floor :13), :82 (unexpected_cache_breaks counter); api/src/types.rs:189 (cache_read_input_tokens tracked)
one_why: Same cautionary pairing as claurst-8 but sharper: claw-code BUILT the cache-loss observability (reason attribution + noise floor, genuinely good) on a default-Anthropic client that never marks a cacheable prefix, so on its primary provider the counter can only ever report zeros -- machinery without the enabling two-line request change.
